/-!
# Policy.CoreV2 — the fix for the anchored day window

A bounty on the v1 wallet paid for a counterexample to "within any stretch shorter than a day, the
wallet pays out at most one day's cap" (`Wallet.Claim.Refute.SlidingDayCap`): the v1 window is
anchored at the first payment after the previous window expired, so the cap can be spent at the
end of one window and again at the start of the next.

v2 changes one thing, the day roll. When a window expires and the new one would start less than
two windows after the old one started, the old window's spending is **carried** into the new window
instead of being reset to zero. The old window's payments happened in `[dayStart, dayStart + dayLength)`;
a new window that starts before `dayStart + 2·dayLength` still lies within one window length of some
of them, so they keep counting; a later window drops them. The state and the policy are the same as v1 (same 32-byte state, same policy bytes), so the
contract shim and the wire format are unchanged; only `step` differs.

The cost: a wallet that spent its whole cap waits up to two windows, instead of one, before it can
spend again. The claim `Wallet.Claim.V2.SlidingDayCap` (in `Policy.Bounties`) says what is gained.
-/
namespace Wallet.V2
open Wallet

/-- Day-window roll with carry. Same expiry test as v1; the subtraction `now - dayStart - dayLength`
is evaluated only after `dayLength ≤ now - dayStart`, so it never wraps. -/
def rollDay (p : Policy) (s : State) (now : UInt64) : State :=
  if s.dayStart ≤ now && p.dayLength ≤ now - s.dayStart then
    if now - s.dayStart - p.dayLength < p.dayLength then { s with dayStart := now }
    else { s with spentToday := 0, dayStart := now }
  else s

/-- The v2 decision function: v1's `step` with `V2.rollDay`. -/
def step (p : Policy) (s : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (amount : UInt64) :
    Verdict × State :=
  if isAllowed to p.allowed then
    if p.perTxCap < amount then (.denyPerTx, s)
    else
      let r := rollDay p s now
      if U64MAX - r.spentTotal < amount || U64MAX - r.spentToday < amount ||
          decide (r.nonce = U64MAX) then (.denyOverflow, s)
      else if p.budgetTotal < r.spentTotal + amount then (.denyBudget, s)
      else if p.perDayCap < r.spentToday + amount then (.denyDaily, s)
      else (.allow, { r with spentTotal := r.spentTotal + amount,
                             spentToday := r.spentToday + amount,
                             nonce := r.nonce + 1 })
  else (.denyReceiver, s)

/-- Fold of `V2.step` over a request list. -/
def run (p : Policy) : State → List Req → State × List Verdict
  | s, [] => (s, [])
  | s, (now, to, amount) :: rest =>
    match step p s now to amount with
    | (v, s') =>
      match run p s' rest with
      | (sf, vs) => (sf, v :: vs)

end Wallet.V2

/-!
# Policy.Core — the spend-policy decision function that runs on NEAR

This module is compiled (Lean → C → wasm32) into the wallet contract, and the
theorems in `Policy.Proofs` are about exactly these definitions.

Executable-subset discipline (the wasm runtime is a minimal C subset of the
Lean runtime: no GMP bignums, no closures, no String primitives, no Init code):

* money and time are `UInt64`; every comparison is overflow-checked, nothing
  relies on wrapping;
* accounts are `List UInt8` (the UTF-8/ASCII bytes of a NEAR account id),
  compared by our own recursive byte equality — no `String`, no `BEq` dictionaries;
* all recursion is first-order and structural; no higher-order functions, so the
  compiler emits no closures; no `Nat` arithmetic on the hot path;
* no `deriving Repr`/string literals here (they would need runtime string
  functions in the module initializer). Pretty-printing lives in `Policy.Examples`.
-/
namespace Wallet

/-- A NEAR account id as its bytes (NEAR ids are ASCII `[a-z0-9._-]`, 2..64 bytes). -/
abbrev Account := List UInt8

/-- The spending policy an owner sets for an agent. Amounts are plain u64 "units". -/
structure Policy where
  /-- Lifetime budget: total ever spent must stay `≤ budgetTotal`. -/
  budgetTotal : UInt64
  /-- Every single payment must be `≤ perTxCap`. -/
  perTxCap    : UInt64
  /-- Spending inside one day window must stay `≤ perDayCap`. -/
  perDayCap   : UInt64
  /-- Length of a day window in nanoseconds (NEAR `block_timestamp` units). -/
  dayLength   : UInt64
  /-- Receiver allowlist. Empty list = deny every payment. -/
  allowed     : List Account

/-- Mutable contract state, persisted between calls. -/
structure State where
  spentTotal : UInt64
  spentToday : UInt64
  /-- Start (ns) of the current day window. -/
  dayStart   : UInt64
  /-- Number of payments allowed so far. -/
  nonce      : UInt64

/-- The outcome of one payment request. -/
inductive Verdict where
  | allow
  | denyBudget
  | denyPerTx
  | denyDaily
  | denyReceiver
  | denyOverflow
deriving DecidableEq

/-- `2^64 - 1`. -/
def U64MAX : UInt64 := 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF

/-- Byte-wise account equality (own recursion: no `BEq`/`DecidableEq` dictionary).
Patterns are exhaustive on purpose: a wildcard arm compiles to a sparse `casesOn`
over `Nat.hasNotBit`, which adds ~0.6 MB to every exported proof closure. -/
def accEq : Account → Account → Bool
  | [], [] => true
  | [], _ :: _ => false
  | _ :: _, [] => false
  | a :: as, b :: bs => decide (a = b) && accEq as bs

/-- `to` occurs in the allowlist. -/
def isAllowed (to : Account) : List Account → Bool
  | [] => false
  | a :: as => accEq a to || isAllowed to as

/-- Day-window roll. The window `[dayStart, dayStart + dayLength)` has expired iff
`dayStart ≤ now ∧ dayLength ≤ now - dayStart`; the subtraction is only evaluated
when `dayStart ≤ now`, so it never wraps, and `dayStart + dayLength` is never
computed (it could overflow). A clock that runs backwards (`now < dayStart`)
never rolls. On a roll the new window starts at `now`. -/
def rollDay (p : Policy) (s : State) (now : UInt64) : State :=
  if s.dayStart ≤ now && p.dayLength ≤ now - s.dayStart then
    { s with spentToday := 0, dayStart := now }
  else s

/-- **The one decision function.**

Checks, in order: receiver allowlisted; `amount ≤ perTxCap`; no u64 overflow of
`spentTotal + amount`, `spentToday + amount` (after the day roll) or `nonce + 1`;
`spentTotal + amount ≤ budgetTotal`; `spentToday + amount ≤ perDayCap`.

Design decision: **a deny returns the input state unchanged** — not even the day
roll or the nonce is written. The roll is recomputed from `dayStart` on the next
request, so committing it only on `allow` loses nothing, and "deny is a no-op"
is the simplest possible audit property (`step_deny_preserves`). -/
def step (p : Policy) (s : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (amount : UInt64) :
    Verdict × State :=
  if isAllowed to p.allowed then
    if p.perTxCap < amount then (.denyPerTx, s)
    else
      let r := rollDay p s now
      if U64MAX - r.spentTotal < amount || U64MAX - r.spentToday < amount ||
          decide (r.nonce = U64MAX) then (.denyOverflow, s)
      else if p.budgetTotal < r.spentTotal + amount then (.denyBudget, s)
      else if p.perDayCap < r.spentToday + amount then (.denyDaily, s)
      else (.allow, { r with spentTotal := r.spentTotal + amount,
                             spentToday := r.spentToday + amount,
                             nonce := r.nonce + 1 })
  else (.denyReceiver, s)

/-- Every element of the first list occurs in the second. -/
def subsetB : List Account → List Account → Bool
  | [], _ => true
  | a :: as, l => isAllowed a l && subsetB as l

/-- `p'` is at most as permissive as `p`: every cap `≤`, allowlist `⊆`, and the
**same** `dayLength` (a different window length is not comparable step-wise:
windows are anchored at the first spend after expiry, so they drift apart). -/
def tighten (p p' : Policy) : Bool :=
  p'.budgetTotal ≤ p.budgetTotal && p'.perTxCap ≤ p.perTxCap &&
  p'.perDayCap ≤ p.perDayCap && decide (p'.dayLength = p.dayLength) &&
  subsetB p'.allowed p.allowed

/-- One payment request: `(now, to, amount)`. -/
abbrev Req := UInt64 × Account × UInt64

/-- Fold of `step` over a request list: final state and the verdict of each request. -/
def run (p : Policy) : State → List Req → State × List Verdict
  | s, [] => (s, [])
  | s, (now, to, amount) :: rest =>
    match step p s now to amount with
    | (v, s') =>
      match run p s' rest with
      | (sf, vs) => (sf, v :: vs)

end Wallet
import Policy.Core
/-!
# Policy.Spec — the claims, as `Prop`s over the exact `Policy.Core` definitions

This file imports nothing but `Policy.Core` and contains no proofs. Each claim is a
closed `Prop`, so a third party (e.g. a bounty) can be asked to "prove
`Wallet.Spec.NoBypassSequence` for this exact `Core`" and the result checked by any
Lean kernel. `Policy.Proofs` / `Policy.SmallProofs` are two independent solutions.
-/
namespace Wallet

/-- The day-roll condition of `rollDay`, as a `Prop`. -/
abbrev Expired (p : Policy) (dayStart now : UInt64) : Prop :=
  dayStart ≤ now ∧ p.dayLength ≤ now - dayStart

/-- ℕ-sum of the amounts of the requests whose verdict is `allow`.
(Exhaustive patterns keep the statement's closure small.) -/
def allowedSum : List Req → List Verdict → Nat
  | [], _ => 0
  | _ :: _, [] => 0
  | (_, _, a) :: rs, v :: vs =>
    match v with
    | .allow => a.toNat + allowedSum rs vs
    | .denyBudget | .denyPerTx | .denyDaily | .denyReceiver | .denyOverflow => allowedSum rs vs

/-- The requests a run allowed, in order. -/
def acceptedReqs : List Req → List Verdict → List Req
  | [], _ => []
  | _ :: _, [] => []
  | r :: rs, v :: vs =>
    match v with
    | .allow => r :: acceptedReqs rs vs
    | .denyBudget | .denyPerTx | .denyDaily | .denyReceiver | .denyOverflow => acceptedReqs rs vs

namespace Spec

/-- Allow ⇒ every bound holds for the new state. -/
def StepAllowBounds : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s s' : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (amount : UInt64),
    step p s now to amount = (.allow, s') →
    s'.spentTotal ≤ p.budgetTotal ∧ s'.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap ∧
    amount ≤ p.perTxCap ∧ to ∈ p.allowed

/-- Deny ⇒ the state is returned unchanged. -/
def StepDenyPreserves : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (amount : UInt64),
    (step p s now to amount).1 ≠ .allow → (step p s now to amount).2 = s

/-- Allow ⇒ no u64 wrap: the ℕ sum fits and is what gets stored. -/
def NoOverflow : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s s' : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (amount : UInt64),
    step p s now to amount = (.allow, s') →
    s.spentTotal.toNat + amount.toNat < 2 ^ 64 ∧
    s'.spentTotal.toNat = s.spentTotal.toNat + amount.toNat

/-- Receivers outside the allowlist are denied, state untouched. -/
def ReceiverGate : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (amount : UInt64),
    to ∉ p.allowed → step p s now to amount = (.denyReceiver, s)

/-- Headline (ℕ form): over ANY request list, what was spent plus everything
allowed never exceeds the lifetime budget. -/
def NoBypassSequence : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s : State) (reqs : List Req),
    s.spentTotal ≤ p.budgetTotal →
    s.spentTotal.toNat + allowedSum reqs (run p s reqs).2 ≤ p.budgetTotal.toNat

/-- Headline (u64 invariant form): the stored total stays within budget over ANY run. -/
def BudgetInvariant : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s : State) (reqs : List Req),
    s.spentTotal ≤ p.budgetTotal → (run p s reqs).1.spentTotal ≤ p.budgetTotal

/-- Within one day window, today's spend plus everything allowed stays within the cap. -/
def NoBypassDaily : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s : State) (reqs : List Req),
    s.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap → (∀ r ∈ reqs, ¬ Expired p s.dayStart r.1) →
    s.spentToday.toNat + allowedSum reqs (run p s reqs).2 ≤ p.perDayCap.toNat

/-!
# Policy.Core — the spend-policy decision function that runs on NEAR

This module is compiled (Lean → C → wasm32) into the wallet contract, and the
theorems in `Policy.Proofs` are about exactly these definitions.

Executable-subset discipline (the wasm runtime is a minimal C subset of the
Lean runtime: no GMP bignums, no closures, no String primitives, no Init code):

* money and time are `UInt64`; every comparison is overflow-checked, nothing
  relies on wrapping;
* accounts are `List UInt8` (the UTF-8/ASCII bytes of a NEAR account id),
  compared by our own recursive byte equality — no `String`, no `BEq` dictionaries;
* all recursion is first-order and structural; no higher-order functions, so the
  compiler emits no closures; no `Nat` arithmetic on the hot path;
* no `deriving Repr`/string literals here (they would need runtime string
  functions in the module initializer). Pretty-printing lives in `Policy.Examples`.
-/
namespace Wallet

/-- A NEAR account id as its bytes (NEAR ids are ASCII `[a-z0-9._-]`, 2..64 bytes). -/
abbrev Account := List UInt8

/-- The spending policy an owner sets for an agent. Amounts are plain u64 "units". -/
structure Policy where
  /-- Lifetime budget: total ever spent must stay `≤ budgetTotal`. -/
  budgetTotal : UInt64
  /-- Every single payment must be `≤ perTxCap`. -/
  perTxCap    : UInt64
  /-- Spending inside one day window must stay `≤ perDayCap`. -/
  perDayCap   : UInt64
  /-- Length of a day window in nanoseconds (NEAR `block_timestamp` units). -/
  dayLength   : UInt64
  /-- Receiver allowlist. Empty list = deny every payment. -/
  allowed     : List Account

/-- Mutable contract state, persisted between calls. -/
structure State where
  spentTotal : UInt64
  spentToday : UInt64
  /-- Start (ns) of the current day window. -/
  dayStart   : UInt64
  /-- Number of payments allowed so far. -/
  nonce      : UInt64

/-- The outcome of one payment request. -/
inductive Verdict where
  | allow
  | denyBudget
  | denyPerTx
  | denyDaily
  | denyReceiver
  | denyOverflow
deriving DecidableEq

/-- `2^64 - 1`. -/
def U64MAX : UInt64 := 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF

/-- Byte-wise account equality (own recursion: no `BEq`/`DecidableEq` dictionary).
Patterns are exhaustive on purpose: a wildcard arm compiles to a sparse `casesOn`
over `Nat.hasNotBit`, which adds ~0.6 MB to every exported proof closure. -/
def accEq : Account → Account → Bool
  | [], [] => true
  | [], _ :: _ => false
  | _ :: _, [] => false
  | a :: as, b :: bs => decide (a = b) && accEq as bs

/-- `to` occurs in the allowlist. -/
def isAllowed (to : Account) : List Account → Bool
  | [] => false
  | a :: as => accEq a to || isAllowed to as

/-- Day-window roll. The window `[dayStart, dayStart + dayLength)` has expired iff
`dayStart ≤ now ∧ dayLength ≤ now - dayStart`; the subtraction is only evaluated
when `dayStart ≤ now`, so it never wraps, and `dayStart + dayLength` is never
computed (it could overflow). A clock that runs backwards (`now < dayStart`)
never rolls. On a roll the new window starts at `now`. -/
def rollDay (p : Policy) (s : State) (now : UInt64) : State :=
  if s.dayStart ≤ now && p.dayLength ≤ now - s.dayStart then
    { s with spentToday := 0, dayStart := now }
  else s

/-- **The one decision function.**

Checks, in order: receiver allowlisted; `amount ≤ perTxCap`; no u64 overflow of
`spentTotal + amount`, `spentToday + amount` (after the day roll) or `nonce + 1`;
`spentTotal + amount ≤ budgetTotal`; `spentToday + amount ≤ perDayCap`.

Design decision: **a deny returns the input state unchanged** — not even the day
roll or the nonce is written. The roll is recomputed from `dayStart` on the next
request, so committing it only on `allow` loses nothing, and "deny is a no-op"
is the simplest possible audit property (`step_deny_preserves`). -/
def step (p : Policy) (s : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (amount : UInt64) :
    Verdict × State :=
  if isAllowed to p.allowed then
    if p.perTxCap < amount then (.denyPerTx, s)
    else
      let r := rollDay p s now
      if U64MAX - r.spentTotal < amount || U64MAX - r.spentToday < amount ||
          decide (r.nonce = U64MAX) then (.denyOverflow, s)
      else if p.budgetTotal < r.spentTotal + amount then (.denyBudget, s)
      else if p.perDayCap < r.spentToday + amount then (.denyDaily, s)
      else (.allow, { r with spentTotal := r.spentTotal + amount,
                             spentToday := r.spentToday + amount,
                             nonce := r.nonce + 1 })
  else (.denyReceiver, s)

/-- Every element of the first list occurs in the second. -/
def subsetB : List Account → List Account → Bool
  | [], _ => true
  | a :: as, l => isAllowed a l && subsetB as l

/-- `p'` is at most as permissive as `p`: every cap `≤`, allowlist `⊆`, and the
**same** `dayLength` (a different window length is not comparable step-wise:
windows are anchored at the first spend after expiry, so they drift apart). -/
def tighten (p p' : Policy) : Bool :=
  p'.budgetTotal ≤ p.budgetTotal && p'.perTxCap ≤ p.perTxCap &&
  p'.perDayCap ≤ p.perDayCap && decide (p'.dayLength = p.dayLength) &&
  subsetB p'.allowed p.allowed

/-- One payment request: `(now, to, amount)`. -/
abbrev Req := UInt64 × Account × UInt64

/-- Fold of `step` over a request list: final state and the verdict of each request. -/
def run (p : Policy) : State → List Req → State × List Verdict
  | s, [] => (s, [])
  | s, (now, to, amount) :: rest =>
    match step p s now to amount with
    | (v, s') =>
      match run p s' rest with
      | (sf, vs) => (sf, v :: vs)

end Wallet

closed `Prop`, so a third party (e.g. a bounty) can be asked to "prove
`Wallet.Spec.NoBypassSequence` for this exact `Core`" and the result checked by any
Lean kernel. `Policy.Proofs` / `Policy.SmallProofs` are two independent solutions.
-/
namespace Wallet

/-- The day-roll condition of `rollDay`, as a `Prop`. -/
abbrev Expired (p : Policy) (dayStart now : UInt64) : Prop :=
  dayStart ≤ now ∧ p.dayLength ≤ now - dayStart

/-- ℕ-sum of the amounts of the requests whose verdict is `allow`.
(Exhaustive patterns keep the statement's closure small.) -/
def allowedSum : List Req → List Verdict → Nat
  | [], _ => 0
  | _ :: _, [] => 0
  | (_, _, a) :: rs, v :: vs =>
    match v with
    | .allow => a.toNat + allowedSum rs vs
    | .denyBudget | .denyPerTx | .denyDaily | .denyReceiver | .denyOverflow => allowedSum rs vs

/-- The requests a run allowed, in order. -/
def acceptedReqs : List Req → List Verdict → List Req
  | [], _ => []
  | _ :: _, [] => []
  | r :: rs, v :: vs =>
    match v with
    | .allow => r :: acceptedReqs rs vs
    | .denyBudget | .denyPerTx | .denyDaily | .denyReceiver | .denyOverflow => acceptedReqs rs vs

/-- Allow ⇒ every bound holds for the new state. -/
def StepAllowBounds : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s s' : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (amount : UInt64),

def NoOverflow : Prop :=

  ∀ (p : Policy) (s : State) (reqs : List Req),

  ∀ (p : Policy) (s : State) (reqs : List Req),

import Policy.Bounties
open Wallet

namespace Solution

theorem N1 (t x n L : Nat) (h1 : t ≤ x) (h2 : n - t < L) (h3 : x ≤ n) : n - x < L := by
  omega

theorem N2 (t x n d L : Nat) (h1 : t ≤ x) (h2 : x - t < L) (h3 : t ≤ n) (h4 : n - t < L)
    (h5 : d ≤ n) (h6 : ¬(d ≤ x ∧ L ≤ x - d)) (h7 : L ≤ n - d) : n - d - L < L := by
  omega

theorem le_n {a b : UInt64} (h : a ≤ b) : a.toNat ≤ b.toNat := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.mp h
theorem n_le {a b : UInt64} (h : a.toNat ≤ b.toNat) : a ≤ b := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.mpr h
theorem lt_n {a b : UInt64} (h : a < b) : a.toNat < b.toNat := by
  have h' : ¬ b.toNat ≤ a.toNat := fun h2 => (UInt64.not_lt.mpr (n_le h2)) h
  exact Nat.lt_of_not_le h'
theorem n_lt {a b : UInt64} (h : a.toNat < b.toNat) : a < b := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hn
  exact Nat.not_le_of_lt h (le_n (UInt64.not_lt.mp hn))

/-- no reset possible within the window for dayStart d -/
def NR (p : Policy) (t0 d : UInt64) : Prop :=
  ∀ n : UInt64, t0 ≤ n → n - t0 < p.dayLength →
    d ≤ n → p.dayLength ≤ n - d → n - d - p.dayLength < p.dayLength

theorem roll_spent (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) (st : State) (n : UInt64)
    (hnr : NR p t0 st.dayStart) (h1 : t0 ≤ n) (h2 : n - t0 < p.dayLength) :
    (V2.rollDay p st n).spentToday = st.spentToday := by
  unfold V2.rollDay
  by_cases hc : (st.dayStart ≤ n && p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart) = true
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    have ha : st.dayStart ≤ n := of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true _ _ ▸ hc).1
    have hb : p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart := of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true _ _ ▸ hc).2
    rw [if_pos (hnr n h1 h2 ha hb)]
  · rw [if_neg hc]

theorem roll_start (p : Policy) (st : State) (n : UInt64) :
    (V2.rollDay p st n).dayStart = n ∨
      ((V2.rollDay p st n).dayStart = st.dayStart ∧ ¬(st.dayStart ≤ n ∧ p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart)) := by
  unfold V2.rollDay
  by_cases hc : (st.dayStart ≤ n && p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart) = true
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    by_cases hd : n - st.dayStart - p.dayLength < p.dayLength
    · rw [if_pos hd]; exact Or.inl rfl
    · rw [if_neg hd]; exact Or.inl rfl
  · rw [if_neg hc]
    refine Or.inr ⟨rfl, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => hc ?_⟩
    simp [a, b]

theorem K (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) (st : State) (x : UInt64)
    (h1 : t0 ≤ x) (h2 : x - t0 < p.dayLength) : NR p t0 (V2.rollDay p st x).dayStart := by
  intro n g1 g2 g3 g4
  rcases roll_start p st x with h | ⟨h, hn⟩
  · rw [h] at g3 g4 ⊢
    exfalso
    have e1 := UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le n t0 g1
    have e2 := UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le n x g3
    have := N1 t0.toNat x.toNat n.toNat p.dayLength.toNat (le_n h1) (e1 ▸ lt_n g2) (le_n g3)
    exact Nat.not_le_of_lt (e2 ▸ this) (le_n g4)
  · rw [h] at g3 g4 ⊢
    have e1 := UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le n t0 g1
    have e2 := UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le n st.dayStart g3
    have e3 := UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le x t0 h1
    have e4 := UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le (n - st.dayStart) p.dayLength g4
    apply n_lt
    rw [e4, e2]
    refine N2 t0.toNat x.toNat n.toNat st.dayStart.toNat p.dayLength.toNat (le_n h1)
      (e3 ▸ lt_n h2) (le_n g1) (e1 ▸ lt_n g2) (le_n g3) ?_ (e2 ▸ le_n g4)
    intro ⟨a, b⟩
    apply hn
    refine ⟨n_le a, n_le ?_⟩
    rw [UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le x st.dayStart (n_le a)]
    exact b

theorem step_spec (p : Policy) (st : State) (x : UInt64) (to : Account) (a : UInt64) :
    (∃ v, v ≠ Verdict.allow ∧ V2.step p st x to a = (v, st)) ∨
    (∃ s', V2.step p st x to a = (.allow, s') ∧
      s'.spentToday = (V2.rollDay p st x).spentToday + a ∧
      (V2.rollDay p st x).spentToday.toNat + a.toNat < 2 ^ 64 ∧
      s'.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap ∧
      s'.dayStart = (V2.rollDay p st x).dayStart) := by
  unfold V2.step
  by_cases h1 : isAllowed to p.allowed = true

    by_cases h2 : p.perTxCap < a
    · rw [if_pos h2]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
    · rw [if_neg h2]
      generalize V2.rollDay p st x = r
      by_cases h3 : (U64MAX - r.spentTotal < a || U64MAX - r.spentToday < a ||
          decide (r.nonce = U64MAX)) = true
      · rw [if_pos h3]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
      · rw [if_neg h3]
        by_cases h4 : p.budgetTotal < r.spentTotal + a
        · rw [if_pos h4]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
        · rw [if_neg h4]
          by_cases h5 : p.perDayCap < r.spentToday + a
          · rw [if_pos h5]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
          · rw [if_neg h5]
            refine Or.inr ⟨_, rfl, rfl, ?_, UInt64.not_lt.mp h5, rfl⟩
            have h6 : ¬ U64MAX - r.spentToday < a := fun h => h3 (by simp [h])
            have h7 := le_n (UInt64.not_lt.mp h6)
            rw [UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le _ _ (n_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (UInt64.toNat_lt _)))] at h7

            exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le h8
  · rw [if_neg h1]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩

theorem toNat_add_ok {a b : UInt64} (h : a.toNat + b.toNat < 2 ^ 64) :
    (a + b).toNat = a.toNat + b.toNat := by
  rw [UInt64.toNat_add]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h

import Policy.Bounties
open Wallet

namespace Solution

theorem N1 (t x n L : Nat) (h1 : t ≤ x) (h2 : n - t < L) (h3 : x ≤ n) : n - x < L := by
  omega

theorem N2 (t x n d L : Nat) (h1 : t ≤ x) (h2 : x - t < L) (h3 : t ≤ n) (h4 : n - t < L)
    (h5 : d ≤ n) (h6 : ¬(d ≤ x ∧ L ≤ x - d)) (h7 : L ≤ n - d) : n - d - L < L := by
  omega

theorem le_n {a b : UInt64} (h : a ≤ b) : a.toNat ≤ b.toNat := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.mp h
theorem n_le {a b : UInt64} (h : a.toNat ≤ b.toNat) : a ≤ b := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.mpr h
theorem lt_n {a b : UInt64} (h : a < b) : a.toNat < b.toNat := by
  have h' : ¬ b.toNat ≤ a.toNat := fun h2 => (UInt64.not_lt.mpr (n_le h2)) h
  exact Nat.lt_of_not_le h'
theorem n_lt {a b : UInt64} (h : a.toNat < b.toNat) : a < b := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hn
  exact Nat.not_le_of_lt h (le_n (UInt64.not_lt.mp hn))

/-- no reset possible within the window for dayStart d -/
def NR (p : Policy) (t0 d : UInt64) : Prop :=
  ∀ n : UInt64, t0 ≤ n → n - t0 < p.dayLength →
    d ≤ n → p.dayLength ≤ n - d → n - d - p.dayLength < p.dayLength

theorem roll_spent (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) (st : State) (n : UInt64)
    (hnr : NR p t0 st.dayStart) (h1 : t0 ≤ n) (h2 : n - t0 < p.dayLength) :
    (V2.rollDay p st n).spentToday = st.spentToday := by
  unfold V2.rollDay
  by_cases hc : (st.dayStart ≤ n && p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart) = true
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    have ha : st.dayStart ≤ n := of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true _ _ ▸ hc).1
    have hb : p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart := of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true _ _ ▸ hc).2
    rw [if_pos (hnr n h1 h2 ha hb)]
  · rw [if_neg hc]

theorem roll_start (p : Policy) (st : State) (n : UInt64) :
    (V2.rollDay p st n).dayStart = n ∨
      ((V2.rollDay p st n).dayStart = st.dayStart ∧ ¬(st.dayStart ≤ n ∧ p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart)) := by
  unfold V2.rollDay
  by_cases hc : (st.dayStart ≤ n && p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart) = true
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    by_cases hd : n - st.dayStart - p.dayLength < p.dayLength
    · rw [if_pos hd]; exact Or.inl rfl
    · rw [if_neg hd]; exact Or.inl rfl
  · rw [if_neg hc]
    refine Or.inr ⟨rfl, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => hc ?_⟩
    simp [a, b]

theorem K (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) (st : State) (x : UInt64)
    (h1 : t0 ≤ x) (h2 : x - t0 < p.dayLength) : NR p t0 (V2.rollDay p st x).dayStart := by
  intro n g1 g2 g3 g4
  rcases roll_start p st x with h | ⟨h, hn⟩
  · rw [h] at g3 g4 ⊢
    exfalso
    have e1 := UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le n t0 g1
    have e2 := UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le n x g3
    have := N1 t0.toNat x.toNat n.toNat p.dayLength.toNat (le_n h1) (e1 ▸ lt_n g2) (le_n g3)
    exact Nat.not_le_of_lt (e2 ▸ this) (le_n g4)
  · rw [h] at g3 g4 ⊢
    have e1 := UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le n t0 g1
    have e2 := UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le n st.dayStart g3
    have e3 := UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le x t0 h1
    have e4 := UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le (n - st.dayStart) p.dayLength g4
    apply n_lt
    rw [e4, e2]
    refine N2 t0.toNat x.toNat n.toNat st.dayStart.toNat p.dayLength.toNat (le_n h1)
      (e3 ▸ lt_n h2) (le_n g1) (e1 ▸ lt_n g2) (le_n g3) ?_ (e2 ▸ le_n g4)
    intro ⟨a, b⟩
    apply hn
    refine ⟨n_le a, n_le ?_⟩
    rw [UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le x st.dayStart (n_le a)]
    exact b

theorem step_spec (p : Policy) (st : State) (x : UInt64) (to : Account) (a : UInt64) :
    (∃ v, v ≠ Verdict.allow ∧ V2.step p st x to a = (v, st)) ∨
    (∃ s', V2.step p st x to a = (.allow, s') ∧
      s'.spentToday = (V2.rollDay p st x).spentToday + a ∧
      (V2.rollDay p st x).spentToday.toNat + a.toNat < 2 ^ 64 ∧
      s'.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap ∧
      s'.dayStart = (V2.rollDay p st x).dayStart) := by
  unfold V2.step
  by_cases h1 : isAllowed to p.allowed = true
  · rw [if_pos h1]
    by_cases h2 : p.perTxCap < a
    · rw [if_pos h2]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
    · rw [if_neg h2]
      generalize V2.rollDay p st x = r
      by_cases h3 : (U64MAX - r.spentTotal < a || U64MAX - r.spentToday < a ||
          decide (r.nonce = U64MAX)) = true
      · rw [if_pos h3]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
      · rw [if_neg h3]
        by_cases h4 : p.budgetTotal < r.spentTotal + a
        · rw [if_pos h4]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
        · rw [if_neg h4]
          by_cases h5 : p.perDayCap < r.spentToday + a
          · rw [if_pos h5]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
          · rw [if_neg h5]
            refine Or.inr ⟨_, rfl, rfl, ?_, UInt64.not_lt.mp h5, rfl⟩
            have h6 : ¬ U64MAX - r.spentToday < a := fun h => h3 (by simp [h])
            have h7 := le_n (UInt64.not_lt.mp h6)
            rw [UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le _ _ (n_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (UInt64.toNat_lt _)))] at h7
            have h8 : r.spentToday.toNat + a.toNat ≤ U64MAX.toNat :=
              Nat.add_comm _ _ ▸ Nat.add_le_of_le_sub (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (UInt64.toNat_lt _)) h7
            exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le h8
  · rw [if_neg h1]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩

theorem toNat_add_ok {a b : UInt64} (h : a.toNat + b.toNat < 2 ^ 64) :
    (a + b).toNat = a.toNat + b.toNat := by
  rw [UInt64.toNat_add]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h

theorem lemA (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) : ∀ (reqs : List Req) (st : State),
    (∀ r ∈ reqs, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength) →
    st.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap → NR p t0 st.dayStart →
    st.spentToday.toNat + allowedSum reqs (V2.run p st reqs).2 ≤ p.perDayCap.toNat
  | [], st, _, hs, _ => le_n hs
  | (x, to, a) :: rest, st, hw, hs, hnr => by
    have hx := hw (x, to, a) (List.Mem.head _)
    have hw' : ∀ r ∈ rest, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength :=
      fun r hr => hw r (List.Mem.tail _ hr)
    rcases step_spec p st x to a with ⟨v, hv, he⟩ | ⟨s', he, e1, e2, e3, e4⟩
    · have ih := lemA p t0 rest st hw' hs hnr
      simp only [V2.run, he]
      cases v <;> first | exact absurd rfl hv | exact ih
    · have ih := lemA p t0 rest s' hw' e3 (e4 ▸ K p t0 st x hx.1 hx.2)
      simp only [V2.run, he, allowedSum]
      rw [e1, toNat_add_ok e2, roll_spent p t0 st x hnr hx.1 hx.2] at ih
      rw [← Nat.add_assoc]; exact ih

theorem lemB (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) : ∀ (reqs : List Req) (st : State),
    (∀ r ∈ reqs, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength) →
    st.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap →
    allowedSum reqs (V2.run p st reqs).2 ≤ p.perDayCap.toNat
  | [], st, _, hs => Nat.zero_le _
  | (x, to, a) :: rest, st, hw, hs => by
    have hx := hw (x, to, a) (List.Mem.head _)
    have hw' : ∀ r ∈ rest, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength :=
      fun r hr => hw r (List.Mem.tail _ hr)
    rcases step_spec p st x to a with ⟨v, hv, he⟩ | ⟨s', he, e1, e2, e3, e4⟩
    · have ih := lemB p t0 rest st hw' hs
      simp only [V2.run, he]
      cases v <;> first | exact absurd rfl hv | exact ih
    · have ih := lemA p t0 rest s' hw' e3 (e4 ▸ K p t0 st x hx.1 hx.2)
      simp only [V2.run, he, allowedSum]
      rw [e1, toNat_add_ok e2] at ih
      exact Nat.le_trans (Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.le_add_left _ _) _)
        (Nat.add_assoc _ _ _ ▸ ih)

theorem proof : Wallet.Claim.V2.SlidingDayCap :=
  fun p s reqs t0 hs hw => lemB p t0 reqs s hw hs

end Solution

import Policy.Bounties
open Wallet

namespace Solution

theorem N1 (t x n L : Nat) (h1 : t ≤ x) (h2 : n - t < L) (h3 : x ≤ n) : n - x < L := by
  omega

theorem N2 (t x n d L : Nat) (h1 : t ≤ x) (h2 : x - t < L) (h3 : t ≤ n) (h4 : n - t < L)
    (h5 : d ≤ n) (h6 : ¬(d ≤ x ∧ L ≤ x - d)) (h7 : L ≤ n - d) : n - d - L < L := by
  omega

theorem le_n {a b : UInt64} (h : a ≤ b) : a.toNat ≤ b.toNat := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.mp h
theorem n_le {a b : UInt64} (h : a.toNat ≤ b.toNat) : a ≤ b := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.mpr h
theorem lt_n {a b : UInt64} (h : a < b) : a.toNat < b.toNat := by
  have h' : ¬ b.toNat ≤ a.toNat := fun h2 => (UInt64.not_lt.mpr (n_le h2)) h
  exact Nat.lt_of_not_le h'
theorem n_lt {a b : UInt64} (h : a.toNat < b.toNat) : a < b := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hn
  exact Nat.not_le_of_lt h (le_n (UInt64.not_lt.mp hn))

/-- no reset possible within the window for dayStart d -/
def NR (p : Policy) (t0 d : UInt64) : Prop :=
  ∀ n : UInt64, t0 ≤ n → n - t0 < p.dayLength →
    d ≤ n → p.dayLength ≤ n - d → n - d - p.dayLength < p.dayLength

theorem roll_spent (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) (st : State) (n : UInt64)
    (hnr : NR p t0 st.dayStart) (h1 : t0 ≤ n) (h2 : n - t0 < p.dayLength) :
    (V2.rollDay p st n).spentToday = st.spentToday := by
  unfold V2.rollDay
  by_cases hc : (st.dayStart ≤ n && p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart) = true
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    have ha : st.dayStart ≤ n := of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true _ _ ▸ hc).1
    have hb : p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart := of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true _ _ ▸ hc).2
    rw [if_pos (hnr n h1 h2 ha hb)]
  · rw [if_neg hc]

theorem roll_start (p : Policy) (st : State) (n : UInt64) :
    (V2.rollDay p st n).dayStart = n ∨
      ((V2.rollDay p st n).dayStart = st.dayStart ∧ ¬(st.dayStart ≤ n ∧ p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart)) := by
  unfold V2.rollDay
  by_cases hc : (st.dayStart ≤ n && p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart) = true
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    by_cases hd : n - st.dayStart - p.dayLength < p.dayLength
    · rw [if_pos hd]; exact Or.inl rfl
    · rw [if_neg hd]; exact Or.inl rfl
  · rw [if_neg hc]
    refine Or.inr ⟨rfl, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => hc ?_⟩
    simp [a, b]

theorem K (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) (st : State) (x : UInt64)
    (h1 : t0 ≤ x) (h2 : x - t0 < p.dayLength) : NR p t0 (V2.rollDay p st x).dayStart := by
  intro n g1 g2 g3 g4
  rcases roll_start p st x with h | ⟨h, hn⟩
  · rw [h] at g3 g4 ⊢
    exfalso
    have e1 := UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le n t0 g1
    have e2 := UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le n x g3
    have := N1 t0.toNat x.toNat n.toNat p.dayLength.toNat (le_n h1) (e1 ▸ lt_n g2) (le_n g3)
    exact Nat.not_le_of_lt (e2 ▸ this) (le_n g4)
  · rw [h] at g3 g4 ⊢
    have e1 := UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le n t0 g1
    have e2 := UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le n st.dayStart g3
    have e3 := UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le x t0 h1
    have e4 := UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le (n - st.dayStart) p.dayLength g4
    apply n_lt
    rw [e4, e2]
    refine N2 t0.toNat x.toNat n.toNat st.dayStart.toNat p.dayLength.toNat (le_n h1)
      (e3 ▸ lt_n h2) (le_n g1) (e1 ▸ lt_n g2) (le_n g3) ?_ (e2 ▸ le_n g4)
    intro ⟨a, b⟩
    apply hn
    refine ⟨n_le a, n_le ?_⟩
    rw [UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le x st.dayStart (n_le a)]
    exact b

theorem step_spec (p : Policy) (st : State) (x : UInt64) (to : Account) (a : UInt64) :
    (∃ v, v ≠ Verdict.allow ∧ V2.step p st x to a = (v, st)) ∨
    (∃ s', V2.step p st x to a = (.allow, s') ∧
      s'.spentToday = (V2.rollDay p st x).spentToday + a ∧
      (V2.rollDay p st x).spentToday.toNat + a.toNat < 2 ^ 64 ∧
      s'.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap ∧
      s'.dayStart = (V2.rollDay p st x).dayStart) := by
  unfold V2.step
  by_cases h1 : isAllowed to p.allowed = true
  · rw [if_pos h1]
    by_cases h2 : p.perTxCap < a
    · rw [if_pos h2]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
    · rw [if_neg h2]
      generalize V2.rollDay p st x = r
      by_cases h3 : (U64MAX - r.spentTotal < a || U64MAX - r.spentToday < a ||
          decide (r.nonce = U64MAX)) = true
      · rw [if_pos h3]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
      · rw [if_neg h3]
        by_cases h4 : p.budgetTotal < r.spentTotal + a
        · rw [if_pos h4]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
        · rw [if_neg h4]
          by_cases h5 : p.perDayCap < r.spentToday + a
          · rw [if_pos h5]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
          · rw [if_neg h5]
            refine Or.inr ⟨_, rfl, rfl, ?_, UInt64.not_lt.mp h5, rfl⟩
            have h6 : ¬ U64MAX - r.spentToday < a := fun h => h3 (by simp [h])
            have h7 := le_n (UInt64.not_lt.mp h6)
            rw [UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le _ _ (n_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (UInt64.toNat_lt _)))] at h7
            have h8 : r.spentToday.toNat + a.toNat ≤ U64MAX.toNat :=
              Nat.add_comm _ _ ▸ Nat.add_le_of_le_sub (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (UInt64.toNat_lt _)) h7
            exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le h8
  · rw [if_neg h1]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩

theorem toNat_add_ok {a b : UInt64} (h : a.toNat + b.toNat < 2 ^ 64) :
    (a + b).toNat = a.toNat + b.toNat := by
  rw [UInt64.toNat_add]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h

theorem lemA (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) : ∀ (reqs : List Req) (st : State),
    (∀ r ∈ reqs, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength) →
    st.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap → NR p t0 st.dayStart →
    st.spentToday.toNat + allowedSum reqs (V2.run p st reqs).2 ≤ p.perDayCap.toNat
  | [], st, _, hs, _ => le_n hs
  | (x, to, a) :: rest, st, hw, hs, hnr => by
    have hx := hw (x, to, a) (List.Mem.head _)
    have hw' : ∀ r ∈ rest, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength :=
      fun r hr => hw r (List.Mem.tail _ hr)
    rcases step_spec p st x to a with ⟨v, hv, he⟩ | ⟨s', he, e1, e2, e3, e4⟩
    · have ih := lemA p t0 rest st hw' hs hnr
      simp only [V2.run, he]
      cases v <;> first | exact absurd rfl hv | exact ih
    · have ih := lemA p t0 rest s' hw' e3 (e4 ▸ K p t0 st x hx.1 hx.2)
      simp only [V2.run, he, allowedSum]
      rw [e1, toNat_add_ok e2, roll_spent p t0 st x hnr hx.1 hx.2] at ih
      rw [← Nat.add_assoc]; exact ih

theorem lemB (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) : ∀ (reqs : List Req) (st : State),
    (∀ r ∈ reqs, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength) →
    st.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap →
    allowedSum reqs (V2.run p st reqs).2 ≤ p.perDayCap.toNat
  | [], st, _, hs => Nat.zero_le _
  | (x, to, a) :: rest, st, hw, hs => by
    have hx := hw (x, to, a) (List.Mem.head _)
    have hw' : ∀ r ∈ rest, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength :=
      fun r hr => hw r (List.Mem.tail _ hr)
    rcases step_spec p st x to a with ⟨v, hv, he⟩ | ⟨s', he, e1, e2, e3, e4⟩
    · have ih := lemB p t0 rest st hw' hs
      simp only [V2.run, he]
      cases v <;> first | exact absurd rfl hv | exact ih
    · have ih := lemA p t0 rest s' hw' e3 (e4 ▸ K p t0 st x hx.1 hx.2)
      simp only [V2.run, he, allowedSum]
      rw [e1, toNat_add_ok e2] at ih
      rw [← Nat.add_assoc] at ih
      exact Nat.le_trans (Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.le_add_left _ _) _) ih

theorem proof : Wallet.Claim.V2.SlidingDayCap :=
  fun p s reqs t0 hs hw => lemB p t0 reqs s hw hs

end Solution

  omega

  exact Nat.not_le_of_lt h (le_n (UInt64.not_lt.mp hn))

def NR (p : Policy) (t0 d : UInt64) : Prop :=
  ∀ n : UInt64, t0 ≤ n → n - t0 < p.dayLength →

import Policy.Bounties
open Wallet

namespace Solution

theorem N1 (t x n L : Nat) (h1 : t ≤ x) (h2 : n - t < L) (_h3 : x ≤ n) : n - x < L :=
  Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le_sub_left h1 n) h2

theorem N2 (t x n d L : Nat) (h1 : t ≤ x) (_h2 : x - t < L) (h3 : t ≤ n) (h4 : n - t < L)
    (h5 : d ≤ n) (h6 : ¬(d ≤ x ∧ L ≤ x - d)) (h7 : L ≤ n - d) : n - d - L < L := by
  have hn : n < L + t := (Nat.sub_lt_iff_lt_add h3).mp h4
  by_cases hd : d ≤ x
  · have hxd : x - d < L := Nat.lt_of_not_le (fun h => h6 ⟨hd, h⟩)
    have hx : x < L + d := (Nat.sub_lt_iff_lt_add hd).mp hxd
    apply Nat.sub_lt_left_of_lt_add h7
    apply (Nat.sub_lt_iff_lt_add h5).mpr
    rw [Nat.add_assoc]
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hn (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.le_trans h1 (Nat.le_of_lt hx)) L)
  · have hx : x < d := Nat.lt_of_not_le hd
    have : n - d < L := (Nat.sub_lt_iff_lt_add h5).mpr
      (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hn (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.le_trans h1 (Nat.le_of_lt hx)) L))
    exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) this

theorem N3 (c b : Nat) (hb : b ≤ 2 ^ 64) : 2 ^ 64 - b + (c + b) = c + 2 ^ 64 := by
  rw [Nat.add_comm c b, ← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.sub_add_cancel hb, Nat.add_comm]

theorem sub_toNat (a b : UInt64) (h : b ≤ a) : (a - b).toNat = a.toNat - b.toNat := by
  have hb : b.toNat ≤ a.toNat := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.mp h
  rw [UInt64.toNat_sub]
  have e := N3 (a.toNat - b.toNat) b.toNat (Nat.le_of_lt (UInt64.toNat_lt b))
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hb] at e
  rw [e, Nat.add_mod_right]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) (UInt64.toNat_lt a))

theorem le_n {a b : UInt64} (h : a ≤ b) : a.toNat ≤ b.toNat := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.mp h
theorem n_le {a b : UInt64} (h : a.toNat ≤ b.toNat) : a ≤ b := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.mpr h
theorem lt_n {a b : UInt64} (h : a < b) : a.toNat < b.toNat := by
  have h' : ¬ b.toNat ≤ a.toNat := fun h2 => (UInt64.not_lt.mpr (n_le h2)) h
  exact Nat.lt_of_not_le h'
theorem n_lt {a b : UInt64} (h : a.toNat < b.toNat) : a < b := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hn
  exact Nat.not_le_of_lt h (le_n (UInt64.not_lt.mp hn))

/-- no reset possible within the window for dayStart d -/
def NR (p : Policy) (t0 d : UInt64) : Prop :=
  ∀ n : UInt64, t0 ≤ n → n - t0 < p.dayLength →
    d ≤ n → p.dayLength ≤ n - d → n - d - p.dayLength < p.dayLength

theorem roll_spent (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) (st : State) (n : UInt64)
    (hnr : NR p t0 st.dayStart) (h1 : t0 ≤ n) (h2 : n - t0 < p.dayLength) :
    (V2.rollDay p st n).spentToday = st.spentToday := by
  unfold V2.rollDay
  by_cases hc : (st.dayStart ≤ n && p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart) = true
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    have ha : st.dayStart ≤ n := of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true _ _ ▸ hc).1
    have hb : p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart := of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true _ _ ▸ hc).2
    rw [if_pos (hnr n h1 h2 ha hb)]
  · rw [if_neg hc]

theorem roll_start (p : Policy) (st : State) (n : UInt64) :
    (V2.rollDay p st n).dayStart = n ∨
      ((V2.rollDay p st n).dayStart = st.dayStart ∧ ¬(st.dayStart ≤ n ∧ p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart)) := by
  unfold V2.rollDay
  by_cases hc : (st.dayStart ≤ n && p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart) = true
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    by_cases hd : n - st.dayStart - p.dayLength < p.dayLength
    · rw [if_pos hd]; exact Or.inl rfl
    · rw [if_neg hd]; exact Or.inl rfl
  · rw [if_neg hc]
    refine Or.inr ⟨rfl, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => hc ?_⟩
    rw [decide_eq_true a, decide_eq_true b]; rfl

theorem K (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) (st : State) (x : UInt64)
    (h1 : t0 ≤ x) (h2 : x - t0 < p.dayLength) : NR p t0 (V2.rollDay p st x).dayStart := by
  intro n g1 g2 g3 g4
  rcases roll_start p st x with h | ⟨h, hn⟩
  · rw [h] at g3 g4 ⊢
    exfalso
    have e1 := sub_toNat n t0 g1
    have e2 := sub_toNat n x g3
    have := N1 t0.toNat x.toNat n.toNat p.dayLength.toNat (le_n h1) (e1 ▸ lt_n g2) (le_n g3)
    exact Nat.not_le_of_lt (e2 ▸ this) (le_n g4)
  · rw [h] at g3 g4 ⊢
    have e1 := sub_toNat n t0 g1
    have e2 := sub_toNat n st.dayStart g3
    have e3 := sub_toNat x t0 h1
    have e4 := sub_toNat (n - st.dayStart) p.dayLength g4
    apply n_lt
    rw [e4, e2]
    refine N2 t0.toNat x.toNat n.toNat st.dayStart.toNat p.dayLength.toNat (le_n h1)
      (e3 ▸ lt_n h2) (le_n g1) (e1 ▸ lt_n g2) (le_n g3) ?_ (e2 ▸ le_n g4)
    intro ⟨a, b⟩
    apply hn
    refine ⟨n_le a, n_le ?_⟩
    rw [sub_toNat x st.dayStart (n_le a)]
    exact b

theorem step_spec (p : Policy) (st : State) (x : UInt64) (to : Account) (a : UInt64) :
    (∃ v, v ≠ Verdict.allow ∧ V2.step p st x to a = (v, st)) ∨
    (∃ s', V2.step p st x to a = (.allow, s') ∧
      s'.spentToday = (V2.rollDay p st x).spentToday + a ∧
      (V2.rollDay p st x).spentToday.toNat + a.toNat < 2 ^ 64 ∧
      s'.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap ∧
      s'.dayStart = (V2.rollDay p st x).dayStart) := by
  unfold V2.step
  by_cases h1 : isAllowed to p.allowed = true
  · rw [if_pos h1]
    by_cases h2 : p.perTxCap < a
    · rw [if_pos h2]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
    · rw [if_neg h2]
      generalize V2.rollDay p st x = r
      by_cases h3 : (U64MAX - r.spentTotal < a || U64MAX - r.spentToday < a ||
          decide (r.nonce = U64MAX)) = true
      · rw [if_pos h3]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
      · rw [if_neg h3]

theorem N1 (t x n L : Nat) (h1 : t ≤ x) (h2 : n - t < L) (_h3 : x ≤ n) : n - x < L :=

theorem SL1 {a b c : Nat} (h : b ≤ a) (h2 : a - b < c) : a < c + b := by
  have e := Nat.add_lt_add_right h2 b
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel h] at e
  exact e

theorem SL2 {a b c : Nat} (h : b ≤ a) (h2 : a < c + b) : a - b < c := by
  rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel h] at h2
  exact Nat.lt_of_add_lt_add_right h2

theorem N2 (t x n d L : Nat) (h1 : t ≤ x) (_h2 : x - t < L) (h3 : t ≤ n) (h4 : n - t < L)
    (h5 : d ≤ n) (h6 : ¬(d ≤ x ∧ L ≤ x - d)) (h7 : L ≤ n - d) : n - d - L < L := by
  have hn : n < L + t := SL1 h3 h4
  by_cases hd : d ≤ x
  · have hxd : x - d < L := Nat.lt_of_not_le (fun h => h6 ⟨hd, h⟩)
    have hx : x < L + d := SL1 hd hxd
    apply SL2 h7
    apply SL2 h5
    rw [Nat.add_assoc]
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hn (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.le_trans h1 (Nat.le_of_lt hx)) L)

    have : n - d < L := (Nat.sub_lt_iff_lt_add h5).mpr

    exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) this

theorem N3 (c b : Nat) (hb : b ≤ 2 ^ 64) : 2 ^ 64 - b + (c + b) = c + 2 ^ 64 := by
  rw [Nat.add_comm c b, ← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.sub_add_cancel hb, Nat.add_comm]

theorem sub_toNat (a b : UInt64) (h : b ≤ a) : (a - b).toNat = a.toNat - b.toNat := by
  have hb : b.toNat ≤ a.toNat := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.mp h
  rw [UInt64.toNat_sub]
  have e := N3 (a.toNat - b.toNat) b.toNat (Nat.le_of_lt (UInt64.toNat_lt b))

theorem n_le {a b : UInt64} (h : a.toNat ≤ b.toNat) : a ≤ b := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.mpr h

/-- no reset possible within the window for dayStart d -/
def NR (p : Policy) (t0 d : UInt64) : Prop :=
  ∀ n : UInt64, t0 ≤ n → n - t0 < p.dayLength →
    d ≤ n → p.dayLength ≤ n - d → n - d - p.dayLength < p.dayLength

theorem roll_spent (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) (st : State) (n : UInt64)

  unfold V2.rollDay
  by_cases hc : (st.dayStart ≤ n && p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart) = true

  by_cases hc : (st.dayStart ≤ n && p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart) = true

import Policy.Bounties
open Wallet

namespace Solution

theorem N1 (t x n L : Nat) (h1 : t ≤ x) (h2 : n - t < L) (_h3 : x ≤ n) : n - x < L :=
  Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le_sub_left h1 n) h2

theorem SL1 {a b c : Nat} (h : b ≤ a) (h2 : a - b < c) : a < c + b := by
  have e := Nat.add_lt_add_right h2 b
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel h] at e
  exact e

theorem SL2 {a b c : Nat} (h : b ≤ a) (h2 : a < c + b) : a - b < c := by
  rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel h] at h2
  exact Nat.lt_of_add_lt_add_right h2

theorem N2 (t x n d L : Nat) (h1 : t ≤ x) (_h2 : x - t < L) (h3 : t ≤ n) (h4 : n - t < L)
    (h5 : d ≤ n) (h6 : ¬(d ≤ x ∧ L ≤ x - d)) (h7 : L ≤ n - d) : n - d - L < L := by
  have hn : n < L + t := SL1 h3 h4
  by_cases hd : d ≤ x
  · have hxd : x - d < L := Nat.lt_of_not_le (fun h => h6 ⟨hd, h⟩)
    have hx : x < L + d := SL1 hd hxd
    apply SL2 h7
    apply SL2 h5
    rw [Nat.add_assoc]
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hn (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.le_trans h1 (Nat.le_of_lt hx)) L)
  · have hx : x < d := Nat.lt_of_not_le hd
    have : n - d < L := SL2 h5
      (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hn (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.le_trans h1 (Nat.le_of_lt hx)) L))
    exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) this

theorem N3 (c b : Nat) (hb : b ≤ 2 ^ 64) : 2 ^ 64 - b + (c + b) = c + 2 ^ 64 := by
  rw [Nat.add_comm c b, ← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.sub_add_cancel hb, Nat.add_comm]

theorem sub_toNat (a b : UInt64) (h : b ≤ a) : (a - b).toNat = a.toNat - b.toNat := by
  have hb : b.toNat ≤ a.toNat := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.mp h
  rw [UInt64.toNat_sub]
  have e := N3 (a.toNat - b.toNat) b.toNat (Nat.le_of_lt (UInt64.toNat_lt b))
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hb] at e
  rw [e, Nat.add_mod_right]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) (UInt64.toNat_lt a))

theorem le_n {a b : UInt64} (h : a ≤ b) : a.toNat ≤ b.toNat := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.mp h
theorem n_le {a b : UInt64} (h : a.toNat ≤ b.toNat) : a ≤ b := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.mpr h
theorem lt_n {a b : UInt64} (h : a < b) : a.toNat < b.toNat := by
  have h' : ¬ b.toNat ≤ a.toNat := fun h2 => (UInt64.not_lt.mpr (n_le h2)) h
  exact Nat.lt_of_not_le h'
theorem n_lt {a b : UInt64} (h : a.toNat < b.toNat) : a < b := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hn
  exact Nat.not_le_of_lt h (le_n (UInt64.not_lt.mp hn))

/-- no reset possible within the window for dayStart d -/
def NR (p : Policy) (t0 d : UInt64) : Prop :=
  ∀ n : UInt64, t0 ≤ n → n - t0 < p.dayLength →
    d ≤ n → p.dayLength ≤ n - d → n - d - p.dayLength < p.dayLength

theorem roll_spent (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) (st : State) (n : UInt64)
    (hnr : NR p t0 st.dayStart) (h1 : t0 ≤ n) (h2 : n - t0 < p.dayLength) :
    (V2.rollDay p st n).spentToday = st.spentToday := by
  unfold V2.rollDay
  by_cases hc : (st.dayStart ≤ n && p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart) = true
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    have ha : st.dayStart ≤ n := of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true _ _ ▸ hc).1
    have hb : p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart := of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true _ _ ▸ hc).2
    rw [if_pos (hnr n h1 h2 ha hb)]
  · rw [if_neg hc]

theorem roll_start (p : Policy) (st : State) (n : UInt64) :
    (V2.rollDay p st n).dayStart = n ∨
      ((V2.rollDay p st n).dayStart = st.dayStart ∧ ¬(st.dayStart ≤ n ∧ p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart)) := by
  unfold V2.rollDay
  by_cases hc : (st.dayStart ≤ n && p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart) = true
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    by_cases hd : n - st.dayStart - p.dayLength < p.dayLength
    · rw [if_pos hd]; exact Or.inl rfl
    · rw [if_neg hd]; exact Or.inl rfl
  · rw [if_neg hc]
    refine Or.inr ⟨rfl, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => hc ?_⟩
    rw [decide_eq_true a, decide_eq_true b]; rfl

theorem K (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) (st : State) (x : UInt64)
    (h1 : t0 ≤ x) (h2 : x - t0 < p.dayLength) : NR p t0 (V2.rollDay p st x).dayStart := by
  intro n g1 g2 g3 g4
  rcases roll_start p st x with h | ⟨h, hn⟩
  · rw [h] at g3 g4 ⊢
    exfalso
    have e1 := sub_toNat n t0 g1
    have e2 := sub_toNat n x g3
    have := N1 t0.toNat x.toNat n.toNat p.dayLength.toNat (le_n h1) (e1 ▸ lt_n g2) (le_n g3)
    exact Nat.not_le_of_lt (e2 ▸ this) (le_n g4)
  · rw [h] at g3 g4 ⊢
    have e1 := sub_toNat n t0 g1
    have e2 := sub_toNat n st.dayStart g3
    have e3 := sub_toNat x t0 h1
    have e4 := sub_toNat (n - st.dayStart) p.dayLength g4
    apply n_lt
    rw [e4, e2]
    refine N2 t0.toNat x.toNat n.toNat st.dayStart.toNat p.dayLength.toNat (le_n h1)
      (e3 ▸ lt_n h2) (le_n g1) (e1 ▸ lt_n g2) (le_n g3) ?_ (e2 ▸ le_n g4)
    intro ⟨a, b⟩
    apply hn
    refine ⟨n_le a, n_le ?_⟩
    rw [sub_toNat x st.dayStart (n_le a)]
    exact b

theorem step_spec (p : Policy) (st : State) (x : UInt64) (to : Account) (a : UInt64) :
    (∃ v, v ≠ Verdict.allow ∧ V2.step p st x to a = (v, st)) ∨
    (∃ s', V2.step p st x to a = (.allow, s') ∧
      s'.spentToday = (V2.rollDay p st x).spentToday + a ∧
      (V2.rollDay p st x).spentToday.toNat + a.toNat < 2 ^ 64 ∧
      s'.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap ∧
      s'.dayStart = (V2.rollDay p st x).dayStart) := by
  unfold V2.step
  by_cases h1 : isAllowed to p.allowed = true
  · rw [if_pos h1]
    by_cases h2 : p.perTxCap < a
    · rw [if_pos h2]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
    · rw [if_neg h2]
      generalize V2.rollDay p st x = r
      by_cases h3 : (U64MAX - r.spentTotal < a || U64MAX - r.spentToday < a ||
          decide (r.nonce = U64MAX)) = true
      · rw [if_pos h3]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
      · rw [if_neg h3]
        by_cases h4 : p.budgetTotal < r.spentTotal + a
        · rw [if_pos h4]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
        · rw [if_neg h4]
          by_cases h5 : p.perDayCap < r.spentToday + a
          · rw [if_pos h5]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
          · rw [if_neg h5]

import Policy.Bounties
open Wallet

namespace Solution

theorem N1 (t x n L : Nat) (h1 : t ≤ x) (h2 : n - t < L) (_h3 : x ≤ n) : n - x < L :=
  Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le_sub_left h1 n) h2

theorem SL1 {a b c : Nat} (h : b ≤ a) (h2 : a - b < c) : a < c + b := by
  have e := Nat.add_lt_add_right h2 b
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel h] at e
  exact e

theorem SL2 {a b c : Nat} (h : b ≤ a) (h2 : a < c + b) : a - b < c := by
  rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel h] at h2
  exact Nat.lt_of_add_lt_add_right h2

theorem N2 (t x n d L : Nat) (h1 : t ≤ x) (_h2 : x - t < L) (h3 : t ≤ n) (h4 : n - t < L)
    (h5 : d ≤ n) (h6 : ¬(d ≤ x ∧ L ≤ x - d)) (h7 : L ≤ n - d) : n - d - L < L := by
  have hn : n < L + t := SL1 h3 h4
  by_cases hd : d ≤ x
  · have hxd : x - d < L := Nat.lt_of_not_le (fun h => h6 ⟨hd, h⟩)
    have hx : x < L + d := SL1 hd hxd
    apply SL2 h7
    apply SL2 h5
    rw [Nat.add_assoc]
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hn (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.le_trans h1 (Nat.le_of_lt hx)) L)
  · have hx : x < d := Nat.lt_of_not_le hd
    have : n - d < L := SL2 h5
      (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hn (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.le_trans h1 (Nat.le_of_lt hx)) L))
    exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) this

theorem N3 (c b : Nat) (hb : b ≤ 2 ^ 64) : 2 ^ 64 - b + (c + b) = c + 2 ^ 64 := by
  rw [Nat.add_comm c b, ← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.sub_add_cancel hb, Nat.add_comm]

theorem sub_toNat (a b : UInt64) (h : b ≤ a) : (a - b).toNat = a.toNat - b.toNat := by
  have hb : b.toNat ≤ a.toNat := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.mp h

theorem N1 (t x n L : Nat) (h1 : t ≤ x) (h2 : n - t < L) (_h3 : x ≤ n) : n - x < L :=

  exact e

import Policy.Bounties
open Wallet

namespace Solution

theorem N1 (t x n L : Nat) (h1 : t ≤ x) (h2 : n - t < L) (_h3 : x ≤ n) : n - x < L :=
  Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le_sub_left h1 n) h2

theorem SL1 {a b c : Nat} (h : b ≤ a) (h2 : a - b < c) : a < c + b := by
  have e := Nat.add_lt_add_right h2 b
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel h] at e
  exact e

theorem SL2 {a b c : Nat} (h : b ≤ a) (h2 : a < c + b) : a - b < c := by
  rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel h] at h2
  exact Nat.lt_of_add_lt_add_right h2

theorem N2 (t x n d L : Nat) (h1 : t ≤ x) (_h2 : x - t < L) (h3 : t ≤ n) (h4 : n - t < L)
    (h5 : d ≤ n) (h6 : ¬(d ≤ x ∧ L ≤ x - d)) (h7 : L ≤ n - d) : n - d - L < L := by
  have hn : n < L + t := SL1 h3 h4
  by_cases hd : d ≤ x
  · have hxd : x - d < L := Nat.lt_of_not_le (fun h => h6 ⟨hd, h⟩)
    have hx : x < L + d := SL1 hd hxd
    apply SL2 h7
    apply SL2 h5
    rw [Nat.add_assoc]
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hn (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.le_trans h1 (Nat.le_of_lt hx)) L)
  · have hx : x < d := Nat.lt_of_not_le hd
    have : n - d < L := SL2 h5
      (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hn (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.le_trans h1 (Nat.le_of_lt hx)) L))
    exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) this

theorem N3 (c b : Nat) (hb : b ≤ 2 ^ 64) : 2 ^ 64 - b + (c + b) = c + 2 ^ 64 := by
  rw [Nat.add_comm c b, ← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.sub_add_cancel hb, Nat.add_comm]

theorem sub_toNat (a b : UInt64) (h : b ≤ a) : (a - b).toNat = a.toNat - b.toNat := by
  have hb : b.toNat ≤ a.toNat := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.mp h
  rw [UInt64.toNat_sub]
  have e := N3 (a.toNat - b.toNat) b.toNat (Nat.le_of_lt (UInt64.toNat_lt b))
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hb] at e
  rw [e, Nat.add_mod_right]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) (UInt64.toNat_lt a))

theorem le_n {a b : UInt64} (h : a ≤ b) : a.toNat ≤ b.toNat := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.mp h
theorem n_le {a b : UInt64} (h : a.toNat ≤ b.toNat) : a ≤ b := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.mpr h
theorem lt_n {a b : UInt64} (h : a < b) : a.toNat < b.toNat := by
  have h' : ¬ b.toNat ≤ a.toNat := fun h2 => (UInt64.not_lt.mpr (n_le h2)) h
  exact Nat.lt_of_not_le h'
theorem n_lt {a b : UInt64} (h : a.toNat < b.toNat) : a < b := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hn
  exact Nat.not_le_of_lt h (le_n (UInt64.not_lt.mp hn))

/-- no reset possible within the window for dayStart d -/
def NR (p : Policy) (t0 d : UInt64) : Prop :=
  ∀ n : UInt64, t0 ≤ n → n - t0 < p.dayLength →
    d ≤ n → p.dayLength ≤ n - d → n - d - p.dayLength < p.dayLength

theorem roll_spent (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) (st : State) (n : UInt64)
    (hnr : NR p t0 st.dayStart) (h1 : t0 ≤ n) (h2 : n - t0 < p.dayLength) :
    (V2.rollDay p st n).spentToday = st.spentToday := by
  unfold V2.rollDay
  by_cases hc : (st.dayStart ≤ n && p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart) = true
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    have ha : st.dayStart ≤ n := of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true _ _ ▸ hc).1
    have hb : p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart := of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true _ _ ▸ hc).2
    rw [if_pos (hnr n h1 h2 ha hb)]
  · rw [if_neg hc]

theorem roll_start (p : Policy) (st : State) (n : UInt64) :
    (V2.rollDay p st n).dayStart = n ∨
      ((V2.rollDay p st n).dayStart = st.dayStart ∧ ¬(st.dayStart ≤ n ∧ p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart)) := by
  unfold V2.rollDay
  by_cases hc : (st.dayStart ≤ n && p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart) = true
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    by_cases hd : n - st.dayStart - p.dayLength < p.dayLength
    · rw [if_pos hd]; exact Or.inl rfl
    · rw [if_neg hd]; exact Or.inl rfl
  · rw [if_neg hc]
    refine Or.inr ⟨rfl, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => hc ?_⟩
    rw [decide_eq_true a, decide_eq_true b]; rfl

theorem K (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) (st : State) (x : UInt64)
    (h1 : t0 ≤ x) (h2 : x - t0 < p.dayLength) : NR p t0 (V2.rollDay p st x).dayStart := by
  intro n g1 g2 g3 g4
  rcases roll_start p st x with h | ⟨h, hn⟩
  · rw [h] at g3 g4 ⊢
    exfalso
    have e1 := sub_toNat n t0 g1
    have e2 := sub_toNat n x g3
    have := N1 t0.toNat x.toNat n.toNat p.dayLength.toNat (le_n h1) (e1 ▸ lt_n g2) (le_n g3)
    exact Nat.not_le_of_lt (e2 ▸ this) (le_n g4)
  · rw [h] at g3 g4 ⊢
    have e1 := sub_toNat n t0 g1
    have e2 := sub_toNat n st.dayStart g3
    have e3 := sub_toNat x t0 h1
    have e4 := sub_toNat (n - st.dayStart) p.dayLength g4
    apply n_lt
    rw [e4, e2]
    refine N2 t0.toNat x.toNat n.toNat st.dayStart.toNat p.dayLength.toNat (le_n h1)
      (e3 ▸ lt_n h2) (le_n g1) (e1 ▸ lt_n g2) (le_n g3) ?_ (e2 ▸ le_n g4)
    intro ⟨a, b⟩
    apply hn
    refine ⟨n_le a, n_le ?_⟩
    rw [sub_toNat x st.dayStart (n_le a)]
    exact b

theorem step_spec (p : Policy) (st : State) (x : UInt64) (to : Account) (a : UInt64) :
    (∃ v, v ≠ Verdict.allow ∧ V2.step p st x to a = (v, st)) ∨
    (∃ s', V2.step p st x to a = (.allow, s') ∧
      s'.spentToday = (V2.rollDay p st x).spentToday + a ∧
      (V2.rollDay p st x).spentToday.toNat + a.toNat < 2 ^ 64 ∧
      s'.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap ∧
      s'.dayStart = (V2.rollDay p st x).dayStart) := by
  unfold V2.step
  by_cases h1 : isAllowed to p.allowed = true
  · rw [if_pos h1]
    by_cases h2 : p.perTxCap < a
    · rw [if_pos h2]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
    · rw [if_neg h2]
      generalize V2.rollDay p st x = r
      by_cases h3 : (U64MAX - r.spentTotal < a || U64MAX - r.spentToday < a ||
          decide (r.nonce = U64MAX)) = true
      · rw [if_pos h3]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
      · rw [if_neg h3]
        by_cases h4 : p.budgetTotal < r.spentTotal + a
        · rw [if_pos h4]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
        · rw [if_neg h4]
          by_cases h5 : p.perDayCap < r.spentToday + a
          · rw [if_pos h5]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
          · rw [if_neg h5]
            refine Or.inr ⟨_, rfl, rfl, ?_, UInt64.not_lt.mp h5, rfl⟩
            have h6 : ¬ U64MAX - r.spentToday < a := fun h => h3 (by rw [decide_eq_true h, Bool.or_true, Bool.true_or])
            have h7 := le_n (UInt64.not_lt.mp h6)
            rw [sub_toNat _ _ (n_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (UInt64.toNat_lt _)))] at h7
            have h8 : r.spentToday.toNat + a.toNat ≤ U64MAX.toNat :=
              Nat.add_comm _ _ ▸ Nat.add_le_of_le_sub (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (UInt64.toNat_lt _)) h7
            exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le h8
  · rw [if_neg h1]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩

theorem toNat_add_ok {a b : UInt64} (h : a.toNat + b.toNat < 2 ^ 64) :
    (a + b).toNat = a.toNat + b.toNat := by
  rw [UInt64.toNat_add]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h

theorem lemA (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) (reqs : List Req) : ∀ (st : State),
    (∀ r ∈ reqs, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength) →
    st.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap → NR p t0 st.dayStart →
    st.spentToday.toNat + allowedSum reqs (V2.run p st reqs).2 ≤ p.perDayCap.toNat := by
  induction reqs with
  | nil => intro st _ hs _; exact le_n hs
  | cons r rest ihr =>
    obtain ⟨x, to, a⟩ := r
    intro st hw hs hnr
    have hx := hw (x, to, a) (List.Mem.head _)
    have hw' : ∀ r ∈ rest, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength :=
      fun r hr => hw r (List.Mem.tail _ hr)
    rcases step_spec p st x to a with ⟨v, hv, he⟩ | ⟨s', he, e1, e2, e3, e4⟩
    · have ih := ihr st hw' hs hnr
      simp only [V2.run, he]
      cases v <;> first | exact absurd rfl hv | exact ih
    · have ih := ihr s' hw' e3 (e4 ▸ K p t0 st x hx.1 hx.2)
      simp only [V2.run, he, allowedSum]
      rw [e1, toNat_add_ok e2, roll_spent p t0 st x hnr hx.1 hx.2] at ih
      rw [← Nat.add_assoc]; exact ih

theorem lemB (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) (reqs : List Req) : ∀ (st : State),
    (∀ r ∈ reqs, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength) →
    st.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap →
    allowedSum reqs (V2.run p st reqs).2 ≤ p.perDayCap.toNat := by
  induction reqs with
  | nil => intro st _ _; exact Nat.zero_le _
  | cons r rest ihr =>
    obtain ⟨x, to, a⟩ := r
    intro st hw hs
    have hx := hw (x, to, a) (List.Mem.head _)
    have hw' : ∀ r ∈ rest, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength :=
      fun r hr => hw r (List.Mem.tail _ hr)
    rcases step_spec p st x to a with ⟨v, hv, he⟩ | ⟨s', he, e1, e2, e3, e4⟩
    · have ih := lemB p t0 rest st hw' hs
      simp only [V2.run, he]
      cases v <;> first | exact absurd rfl hv | exact ih
    · have ih := lemA p t0 rest s' hw' e3 (e4 ▸ K p t0 st x hx.1 hx.2)
      simp only [V2.run, he, allowedSum]
      rw [e1, toNat_add_ok e2] at ih
      exact Nat.le_trans (Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.le_add_left _ _) _) ih

theorem proof : Wallet.Claim.V2.SlidingDayCap :=
  fun p s reqs t0 hs hw => lemB p t0 reqs s hw hs

end Solution

import Policy.Bounties
open Wallet

namespace Solution

theorem N1 (t x n L : Nat) (h1 : t ≤ x) (h2 : n - t < L) (_h3 : x ≤ n) : n - x < L :=
  Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le_sub_left h1 n) h2

theorem SL1 {a b c : Nat} (h : b ≤ a) (h2 : a - b < c) : a < c + b := by
  have e := Nat.add_lt_add_right h2 b
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel h] at e
  exact e

theorem SL2 {a b c : Nat} (h : b ≤ a) (h2 : a < c + b) : a - b < c := by
  rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel h] at h2
  exact Nat.lt_of_add_lt_add_right h2

theorem N2 (t x n d L : Nat) (h1 : t ≤ x) (_h2 : x - t < L) (h3 : t ≤ n) (h4 : n - t < L)
    (h5 : d ≤ n) (h6 : ¬(d ≤ x ∧ L ≤ x - d)) (h7 : L ≤ n - d) : n - d - L < L := by
  have hn : n < L + t := SL1 h3 h4
  by_cases hd : d ≤ x
  · have hxd : x - d < L := Nat.lt_of_not_le (fun h => h6 ⟨hd, h⟩)
    have hx : x < L + d := SL1 hd hxd
    apply SL2 h7
    apply SL2 h5
    rw [Nat.add_assoc]
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hn (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.le_trans h1 (Nat.le_of_lt hx)) L)
  · have hx : x < d := Nat.lt_of_not_le hd
    have : n - d < L := SL2 h5
      (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hn (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.le_trans h1 (Nat.le_of_lt hx)) L))
    exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) this

theorem N3 (c b : Nat) (hb : b ≤ 2 ^ 64) : 2 ^ 64 - b + (c + b) = c + 2 ^ 64 := by
  rw [Nat.add_comm c b, ← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.sub_add_cancel hb, Nat.add_comm]

theorem sub_toNat (a b : UInt64) (h : b ≤ a) : (a - b).toNat = a.toNat - b.toNat := by
  have hb : b.toNat ≤ a.toNat := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.mp h
  rw [UInt64.toNat_sub]
  have e := N3 (a.toNat - b.toNat) b.toNat (Nat.le_of_lt (UInt64.toNat_lt b))
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hb] at e
  rw [e, Nat.add_mod_right]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) (UInt64.toNat_lt a))

theorem le_n {a b : UInt64} (h : a ≤ b) : a.toNat ≤ b.toNat := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.mp h
theorem n_le {a b : UInt64} (h : a.toNat ≤ b.toNat) : a ≤ b := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.mpr h
theorem lt_n {a b : UInt64} (h : a < b) : a.toNat < b.toNat := by
  have h' : ¬ b.toNat ≤ a.toNat := fun h2 => (UInt64.not_lt.mpr (n_le h2)) h
  exact Nat.lt_of_not_le h'
theorem n_lt {a b : UInt64} (h : a.toNat < b.toNat) : a < b := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hn
  exact Nat.not_le_of_lt h (le_n (UInt64.not_lt.mp hn))

/-- no reset possible within the window for dayStart d -/
def NR (p : Policy) (t0 d : UInt64) : Prop :=
  ∀ n : UInt64, t0 ≤ n → n - t0 < p.dayLength →
    d ≤ n → p.dayLength ≤ n - d → n - d - p.dayLength < p.dayLength

theorem roll_spent (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) (st : State) (n : UInt64)
    (hnr : NR p t0 st.dayStart) (h1 : t0 ≤ n) (h2 : n - t0 < p.dayLength) :
    (V2.rollDay p st n).spentToday = st.spentToday := by
  unfold V2.rollDay
  by_cases hc : (st.dayStart ≤ n && p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart) = true
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    have ha : st.dayStart ≤ n := of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true _ _ ▸ hc).1
    have hb : p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart := of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true _ _ ▸ hc).2
    rw [if_pos (hnr n h1 h2 ha hb)]
  · rw [if_neg hc]

theorem roll_start (p : Policy) (st : State) (n : UInt64) :
    (V2.rollDay p st n).dayStart = n ∨
      ((V2.rollDay p st n).dayStart = st.dayStart ∧ ¬(st.dayStart ≤ n ∧ p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart)) := by
  unfold V2.rollDay
  by_cases hc : (st.dayStart ≤ n && p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart) = true
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    by_cases hd : n - st.dayStart - p.dayLength < p.dayLength
    · rw [if_pos hd]; exact Or.inl rfl
    · rw [if_neg hd]; exact Or.inl rfl
  · rw [if_neg hc]
    refine Or.inr ⟨rfl, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => hc ?_⟩
    rw [decide_eq_true a, decide_eq_true b]; rfl

theorem K (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) (st : State) (x : UInt64)
    (h1 : t0 ≤ x) (h2 : x - t0 < p.dayLength) : NR p t0 (V2.rollDay p st x).dayStart := by
  intro n g1 g2 g3 g4
  rcases roll_start p st x with h | ⟨h, hn⟩
  · rw [h] at g3 g4 ⊢
    exfalso
    have e1 := sub_toNat n t0 g1
    have e2 := sub_toNat n x g3
    have := N1 t0.toNat x.toNat n.toNat p.dayLength.toNat (le_n h1) (e1 ▸ lt_n g2) (le_n g3)
    exact Nat.not_le_of_lt (e2 ▸ this) (le_n g4)
  · rw [h] at g3 g4 ⊢
    have e1 := sub_toNat n t0 g1
    have e2 := sub_toNat n st.dayStart g3
    have e3 := sub_toNat x t0 h1
    have e4 := sub_toNat (n - st.dayStart) p.dayLength g4
    apply n_lt
    rw [e4, e2]
    refine N2 t0.toNat x.toNat n.toNat st.dayStart.toNat p.dayLength.toNat (le_n h1)
      (e3 ▸ lt_n h2) (le_n g1) (e1 ▸ lt_n g2) (le_n g3) ?_ (e2 ▸ le_n g4)
    intro ⟨a, b⟩
    apply hn
    refine ⟨n_le a, n_le ?_⟩
    rw [sub_toNat x st.dayStart (n_le a)]
    exact b

theorem step_spec (p : Policy) (st : State) (x : UInt64) (to : Account) (a : UInt64) :
    (∃ v, v ≠ Verdict.allow ∧ V2.step p st x to a = (v, st)) ∨
    (∃ s', V2.step p st x to a = (.allow, s') ∧
      s'.spentToday = (V2.rollDay p st x).spentToday + a ∧
      (V2.rollDay p st x).spentToday.toNat + a.toNat < 2 ^ 64 ∧
      s'.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap ∧
      s'.dayStart = (V2.rollDay p st x).dayStart) := by
  unfold V2.step
  by_cases h1 : isAllowed to p.allowed = true
  · rw [if_pos h1]
    by_cases h2 : p.perTxCap < a
    · rw [if_pos h2]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
    · rw [if_neg h2]
      generalize V2.rollDay p st x = r
      by_cases h3 : (U64MAX - r.spentTotal < a || U64MAX - r.spentToday < a ||
          decide (r.nonce = U64MAX)) = true
      · rw [if_pos h3]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
      · rw [if_neg h3]
        by_cases h4 : p.budgetTotal < r.spentTotal + a
        · rw [if_pos h4]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
        · rw [if_neg h4]
          by_cases h5 : p.perDayCap < r.spentToday + a
          · rw [if_pos h5]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
          · rw [if_neg h5]
            refine Or.inr ⟨_, rfl, rfl, ?_, UInt64.not_lt.mp h5, rfl⟩
            have h6 : ¬ U64MAX - r.spentToday < a := fun h => h3 (by rw [decide_eq_true h, Bool.or_true, Bool.true_or])
            have h7 := le_n (UInt64.not_lt.mp h6)
            rw [sub_toNat _ _ (n_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (UInt64.toNat_lt _)))] at h7
            have h8 : r.spentToday.toNat + a.toNat ≤ U64MAX.toNat :=
              Nat.add_comm _ _ ▸ Nat.add_le_of_le_sub (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (UInt64.toNat_lt _)) h7
            exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le h8
  · rw [if_neg h1]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩

theorem toNat_add_ok {a b : UInt64} (h : a.toNat + b.toNat < 2 ^ 64) :
    (a + b).toNat = a.toNat + b.toNat := by
  rw [UInt64.toNat_add]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h

theorem lemA (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) (reqs : List Req) : ∀ (st : State),
    (∀ r ∈ reqs, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength) →
    st.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap → NR p t0 st.dayStart →
    st.spentToday.toNat + allowedSum reqs (V2.run p st reqs).2 ≤ p.perDayCap.toNat := by
  induction reqs with
  | nil => intro st _ hs _; exact le_n hs
  | cons r rest ihr =>
    obtain ⟨x, to, a⟩ := r
    intro st hw hs hnr
    have hx := hw (x, to, a) (List.Mem.head _)
    have hw' : ∀ r ∈ rest, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength :=
      fun r hr => hw r (List.Mem.tail _ hr)
    rcases step_spec p st x to a with ⟨v, hv, he⟩ | ⟨s', he, e1, e2, e3, e4⟩
    · have ih := ihr st hw' hs hnr
      simp only [V2.run, he]
      cases v <;> first | exact absurd rfl hv | exact ih
    · have ih := ihr s' hw' e3 (e4 ▸ K p t0 st x hx.1 hx.2)
      simp only [V2.run, he, allowedSum]
      rw [e1, toNat_add_ok e2, roll_spent p t0 st x hnr hx.1 hx.2] at ih
      rw [← Nat.add_assoc]; exact ih

theorem lemB (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) (reqs : List Req) : ∀ (st : State),
    (∀ r ∈ reqs, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength) →
    st.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap →
    allowedSum reqs (V2.run p st reqs).2 ≤ p.perDayCap.toNat := by
  induction reqs with
  | nil => intro st _ _; exact Nat.zero_le _
  | cons r rest ihr =>
    obtain ⟨x, to, a⟩ := r
    intro st hw hs
    have hx := hw (x, to, a) (List.Mem.head _)
    have hw' : ∀ r ∈ rest, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength :=
      fun r hr => hw r (List.Mem.tail _ hr)
    rcases step_spec p st x to a with ⟨v, hv, he⟩ | ⟨s', he, e1, e2, e3, e4⟩
    · have ih := ihr st hw' hs
      simp only [V2.run, he]
      cases v <;> first | exact absurd rfl hv | exact ih
    · have ih := lemA p t0 rest s' hw' e3 (e4 ▸ K p t0 st x hx.1 hx.2)
      simp only [V2.run, he, allowedSum]
      rw [e1, toNat_add_ok e2] at ih
      exact Nat.le_trans (Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.le_add_left _ _) _) ih

theorem proof : Wallet.Claim.V2.SlidingDayCap :=
  fun p s reqs t0 hs hw => lemB p t0 reqs s hw hs

import Policy.Bounties
open Wallet

namespace Solution

theorem N1 (t x n L : Nat) (h1 : t ≤ x) (h2 : n - t < L) (_h3 : x ≤ n) : n - x < L :=
  Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le_sub_left h1 n) h2

theorem SL1 {a b c : Nat} (h : b ≤ a) (h2 : a - b < c) : a < c + b := by
  have e := Nat.add_lt_add_right h2 b
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel h] at e
  exact e

theorem SL2 {a b c : Nat} (h : b ≤ a) (h2 : a < c + b) : a - b < c := by
  rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel h] at h2
  exact Nat.lt_of_add_lt_add_right h2

theorem N2 (t x n d L : Nat) (h1 : t ≤ x) (_h2 : x - t < L) (h3 : t ≤ n) (h4 : n - t < L)
    (h5 : d ≤ n) (h6 : ¬(d ≤ x ∧ L ≤ x - d)) (h7 : L ≤ n - d) : n - d - L < L := by
  have hn : n < L + t := SL1 h3 h4
  by_cases hd : d ≤ x
  · have hxd : x - d < L := Nat.lt_of_not_le (fun h => h6 ⟨hd, h⟩)
    have hx : x < L + d := SL1 hd hxd
    apply SL2 h7
    apply SL2 h5
    rw [Nat.add_assoc]
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hn (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.le_trans h1 (Nat.le_of_lt hx)) L)
  · have hx : x < d := Nat.lt_of_not_le hd
    have : n - d < L := SL2 h5
      (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hn (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.le_trans h1 (Nat.le_of_lt hx)) L))
    exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) this

theorem N3 (c b : Nat) (hb : b ≤ 2 ^ 64) : 2 ^ 64 - b + (c + b) = c + 2 ^ 64 := by
  rw [Nat.add_comm c b, ← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.sub_add_cancel hb, Nat.add_comm]

theorem sub_toNat (a b : UInt64) (h : b ≤ a) : (a - b).toNat = a.toNat - b.toNat := by
  have hb : b.toNat ≤ a.toNat := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.mp h
  rw [UInt64.toNat_sub]
  have e := N3 (a.toNat - b.toNat) b.toNat (Nat.le_of_lt (UInt64.toNat_lt b))
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hb] at e
  rw [e, Nat.add_mod_right]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) (UInt64.toNat_lt a))

theorem le_n {a b : UInt64} (h : a ≤ b) : a.toNat ≤ b.toNat := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.mp h
theorem n_le {a b : UInt64} (h : a.toNat ≤ b.toNat) : a ≤ b := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.mpr h
theorem lt_n {a b : UInt64} (h : a < b) : a.toNat < b.toNat := by
  have h' : ¬ b.toNat ≤ a.toNat := fun h2 => (UInt64.not_lt.mpr (n_le h2)) h
  exact Nat.lt_of_not_le h'
theorem n_lt {a b : UInt64} (h : a.toNat < b.toNat) : a < b := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hn
  exact Nat.not_le_of_lt h (le_n (UInt64.not_lt.mp hn))

/-- no reset possible within the window for dayStart d -/
def NR (p : Policy) (t0 d : UInt64) : Prop :=
  ∀ n : UInt64, t0 ≤ n → n - t0 < p.dayLength →
    d ≤ n → p.dayLength ≤ n - d → n - d - p.dayLength < p.dayLength

theorem roll_spent (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) (st : State) (n : UInt64)
    (hnr : NR p t0 st.dayStart) (h1 : t0 ≤ n) (h2 : n - t0 < p.dayLength) :
    (V2.rollDay p st n).spentToday = st.spentToday := by
  unfold V2.rollDay
  by_cases hc : (st.dayStart ≤ n && p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart) = true
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    have ha : st.dayStart ≤ n := of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true _ _ ▸ hc).1
    have hb : p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart := of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true _ _ ▸ hc).2
    rw [if_pos (hnr n h1 h2 ha hb)]
  · rw [if_neg hc]

theorem roll_start (p : Policy) (st : State) (n : UInt64) :
    (V2.rollDay p st n).dayStart = n ∨
      ((V2.rollDay p st n).dayStart = st.dayStart ∧ ¬(st.dayStart ≤ n ∧ p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart)) := by
  unfold V2.rollDay
  by_cases hc : (st.dayStart ≤ n && p.dayLength ≤ n - st.dayStart) = true
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    by_cases hd : n - st.dayStart - p.dayLength < p.dayLength
    · rw [if_pos hd]; exact Or.inl rfl
    · rw [if_neg hd]; exact Or.inl rfl
  · rw [if_neg hc]
    refine Or.inr ⟨rfl, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => hc ?_⟩
    rw [decide_eq_true a, decide_eq_true b]; rfl

theorem K (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) (st : State) (x : UInt64)
    (h1 : t0 ≤ x) (h2 : x - t0 < p.dayLength) : NR p t0 (V2.rollDay p st x).dayStart := by
  intro n g1 g2 g3 g4
  rcases roll_start p st x with h | ⟨h, hn⟩
  · rw [h] at g3 g4 ⊢
    exfalso
    have e1 := sub_toNat n t0 g1
    have e2 := sub_toNat n x g3
    have := N1 t0.toNat x.toNat n.toNat p.dayLength.toNat (le_n h1) (e1 ▸ lt_n g2) (le_n g3)
    exact Nat.not_le_of_lt (e2 ▸ this) (le_n g4)
  · rw [h] at g3 g4 ⊢
    have e1 := sub_toNat n t0 g1
    have e2 := sub_toNat n st.dayStart g3
    have e3 := sub_toNat x t0 h1
    have e4 := sub_toNat (n - st.dayStart) p.dayLength g4
    apply n_lt
    rw [e4, e2]
    refine N2 t0.toNat x.toNat n.toNat st.dayStart.toNat p.dayLength.toNat (le_n h1)
      (e3 ▸ lt_n h2) (le_n g1) (e1 ▸ lt_n g2) (le_n g3) ?_ (e2 ▸ le_n g4)
    intro ⟨a, b⟩
    apply hn
    refine ⟨n_le a, n_le ?_⟩
    rw [sub_toNat x st.dayStart (n_le a)]
    exact b

theorem step_spec (p : Policy) (st : State) (x : UInt64) (to : Account) (a : UInt64) :
    (∃ v, v ≠ Verdict.allow ∧ V2.step p st x to a = (v, st)) ∨
    (∃ s', V2.step p st x to a = (.allow, s') ∧
      s'.spentToday = (V2.rollDay p st x).spentToday + a ∧
      (V2.rollDay p st x).spentToday.toNat + a.toNat < 2 ^ 64 ∧
      s'.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap ∧
      s'.dayStart = (V2.rollDay p st x).dayStart) := by
  unfold V2.step
  by_cases h1 : isAllowed to p.allowed = true
  · rw [if_pos h1]
    by_cases h2 : p.perTxCap < a
    · rw [if_pos h2]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
    · rw [if_neg h2]
      generalize V2.rollDay p st x = r
      by_cases h3 : (U64MAX - r.spentTotal < a || U64MAX - r.spentToday < a ||
          decide (r.nonce = U64MAX)) = true
      · rw [if_pos h3]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
      · rw [if_neg h3]
        by_cases h4 : p.budgetTotal < r.spentTotal + a
        · rw [if_pos h4]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
        · rw [if_neg h4]
          by_cases h5 : p.perDayCap < r.spentToday + a
          · rw [if_pos h5]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩
          · rw [if_neg h5]
            refine Or.inr ⟨_, rfl, rfl, ?_, UInt64.not_lt.mp h5, rfl⟩
            have h6 : ¬ U64MAX - r.spentToday < a := fun h => h3 (by rw [decide_eq_true h, Bool.or_true, Bool.true_or])
            have h7 := le_n (UInt64.not_lt.mp h6)
            rw [sub_toNat _ _ (n_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (UInt64.toNat_lt _)))] at h7
            have h8 : r.spentToday.toNat + a.toNat ≤ U64MAX.toNat :=
              Nat.add_comm _ _ ▸ Nat.add_le_of_le_sub (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (UInt64.toNat_lt _)) h7
            exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le h8
  · rw [if_neg h1]; exact Or.inl ⟨_, fun h => Verdict.noConfusion h, rfl⟩

theorem toNat_add_ok {a b : UInt64} (h : a.toNat + b.toNat < 2 ^ 64) :
    (a + b).toNat = a.toNat + b.toNat := by
  rw [UInt64.toNat_add]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h

theorem lemA (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) (reqs : List Req) : ∀ (st : State),
    (∀ r ∈ reqs, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength) →
    st.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap → NR p t0 st.dayStart →
    st.spentToday.toNat + allowedSum reqs (V2.run p st reqs).2 ≤ p.perDayCap.toNat := by
  induction reqs with
  | nil => intro st _ hs _; exact le_n hs
  | cons r rest ihr =>
    obtain ⟨x, to, a⟩ := r
    intro st hw hs hnr
    have hx := hw (x, to, a) (List.Mem.head _)
    have hw' : ∀ r ∈ rest, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength :=
      fun r hr => hw r (List.Mem.tail _ hr)
    rcases step_spec p st x to a with ⟨v, hv, he⟩ | ⟨s', he, e1, e2, e3, e4⟩
    · have ih := ihr st hw' hs hnr
      simp only [V2.run, he]
      cases v <;> first | exact absurd rfl hv | exact ih
    · have ih := ihr s' hw' e3 (e4 ▸ K p t0 st x hx.1 hx.2)
      simp only [V2.run, he, allowedSum]
      rw [e1, toNat_add_ok e2, roll_spent p t0 st x hnr hx.1 hx.2] at ih
      rw [← Nat.add_assoc]; exact ih

theorem proof : Wallet.Claim.V2.SlidingDayCap :=
  fun p s reqs t0 hs hw => (lemA p t0 reqs s hw hs).2

end Solution
